limitations: Not an independent human assessment, penetration test, compliance audit, certification or exhaustive audit.
287 CodeQL alerts remain open: 10 high, 127 medium and 150 unrated scanner classifications. Alert 320 is a bounded test-fixture false positive; no alerts were dismissed.
No deployed-production or real provider/SMTP/OIDC assurance; unperformed manual device and screen-reader checks remain unverified.
Historical resolved findings retain historical reproductions; current regression is exact-candidate evidence, not fresh reproduction of every historical defect.
CSP/COEP explicitly accepted October 20 for f52b210 only, review before next runtime candidate or November 12. Mailpit exception expires October 24 without renewal.
Validation composes local and hosted gates. Original local provisioning/exit failures and pre-publication HTTP 502 remain recorded; release Build passed attempt 1.
Trusted-role arbitrary SQL and host administrators remain outside the claimed boundary; TD-RISK-073 remains approved 1.x work.
